in_marathi.name: Chitralekha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Artful, Sketch, Image
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chitralekha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chitra: Sketch, Art; Lekha: Image, Mark. Chitralekha means a beautiful sketch or image. In Hindu mythology, Chitralekha was the name of a divine artist who could draw anything from her mind.
